resources.string: This service reads message content from apps like WhatsApp to detect scams in real-time.
A caller claims your account is frozen or your card is blocked, demanding your OTP, CVV, or passwords for "verification." Remember: Banks never ask for sensitive data over the phone.
A call informs you that you\'ve won a large prize or lottery, but first, you must pay a "processing fee" or "tax." This is a lie. Legitimate winnings do not require upfront payment.
The caller threatens immediate service disconnection (e.g., electricity, internet) if an urgent payment isn\'t made. Always hang up and call the utility company using a publicly verified number.
This involves a scammer guiding you to a malicious website or convincing you to click a link sent via text/email to steal your credentials. Never click unverified links during a call.
NEVER share any sensitive information—PINs, OTPs, Passwords, or personal IDs—with unsolicited callers. Legitimate organizations have this data or use secure methods for verification.
